PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Composite Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Composite Materials.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Composite Materials.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Composite Materials.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Composite Materials.

2. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Run with the tool

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

4. When learning Plane Geometry, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Plane Geometry.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Plane Geometry.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Plane Geometry.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Plane Geometry.

5. When learning Computer Software, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Software.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Software.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Software.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Software.

6. When learning Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.

7. When learning Data Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Safety.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Data Safety.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Safety.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Safety.

8. When learning Ceramic Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ceramic Materials.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ceramic Materials.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Ceramic Materials.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ceramic Materials.

9. When learning Dimensioning, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Dimensioning.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Dimensioning.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Dimensioning.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Dimensioning.

10. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

11. When learning Plain Scale Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Plain Scale Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Plain Scale Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Plain Scale Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Plain Scale Drawing.

12. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
